response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.recordvault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), status_totals AS (SELECT orderflow, SUM(cnt) as status_total, COUNT(*) as combo_count FROM counts GROUP BY orderflow), combo_stats AS (SELECT c.recordvault, c.orderflow, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / st.status_total as share, 1.0 / st.combo_count as avg_share FROM counts c JOIN status_totals st ON c.orderflow = st.orderflow) SELECT recordvault, orderflow, cnt, share, share - avg_share as gap_above_avg FROM combo_stats WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

alternatives.interpretation: Show the top 10 combinations by absolute deviation from their status's average share, without filtering for those above average. This ranks combinations by magnitude of deviation in either direction.
